summary: Component Plan + state contracts for the work-order-rail chat Surface: 20 requirements resolved (12 create, 1 extend, 7 native; no registry or primitives invented), token roles by semantic name, per-breakpoint responsive behavior, full a11y contracts, per-component state tables covering every reachable matrix row with unreachable states excluded, and a dependency-ordered build wave sequence.

claims.claim: Run inventory is greenfield: no canonical DESIGN.md registry and no UI components exist in the product tree
No installed accessible primitive exists in the prototype toolchain (dependencies are ajv only)
Every Surface Brief requirement (20 items) carries one 9-field resolution record; every create/extend record carries non-empty rejected-alternatives with rung numbers
All token citations use semantic role names, never raw values or primitive refs
State contracts cover every reachable state-matrix row (A1-A4, B1-B7, C1-C6, D1-D7, E1-E4, F1-F9, G1-G5, H, I); unreachable states are excluded with reasons
StripSpine is a responsive variant of SpineNavigator (extend), not a second component; FootnoteBlock and LiveRegion are native patterns

decisions.choice: Separate WorkOrderTicket (card), ToolTraceRow (ruled row, never card), ExpandedWell (inset variant host) honoring CARD-SOUP GUARD
rationale: CARD-SOUP GUARD allows exactly one elevated card per viewport; rows must be hairline-ruled, never cards
One-well-open-per-ticket and elevation discipline need distinct owners (ticket owns well slot, row owns chevron)
risks: Builder merges well into row and breaks one-open rule — Auditor checks ticket-owned slot
revisitWhen: If Builder proves one-open rule cheaper inside row with ticket pass-through

decisions.choice: Single DrawerSheet contract wrapping native dialog for all three sheets with tether, stacking, one-layer Esc, opener return
rationale: Three hand-wired dialogs repeat trap/tether/stacking/announce logic and drift
Native dialog supplies modality + top-layer + return; wrapper adds tether/stacking/scrim/reduced-motion consistently
alternatives: Bare native dialog per call site
risks: Hand-rolled stacking + trap without installed primitive needs audit focus
revisitWhen: If an accessible primitive is installed later, re-resolve rung 5

decisions.choice: StripSpine as extend-variant of SpineNavigator sharing props, state, selection, and announcements
rationale: Second component for one requirement duplicates compression/selection logic and invites divergent announcements
Responsive Model defines strip as presentation change (visuals, carriage hidden, chip), not new behavior
risks: Builder implements strip as fork — gate reads extend record to prevent it
revisitWhen: Never within this Run; strip stays a variant

decisions.choice: Shared EmptyFrame contract for all nine empty/error slots rendering in place with recovery action
rationale: Nine copies drift in border, wording, and recovery wiring; one contract keeps dashed in-place discipline
Overlays are forbidden (T3 never overlays T1); EmptyFrame renders in place by contract
risks: Over-general props (title/body/action free text) could dilute cite-back wording — constrain via state contracts
revisitWhen: If any slot needs behavior beyond message + one recovery action

decisions.choice: ToolTraceRow + ExpandedWell as button-controlled disclosure (aria-expanded/controls); details/summary refused with recorded reason
rationale: details/summary cannot enforce one-open-per-ticket, cite stamping, or variant bodies without JS that defeats its honesty
Div-click handlers are forbidden (IA keyboard contract: native buttons/tabs/links only)
risks: None beyond audit load; button disclosure is standard
revisitWhen: If one-open rule is dropped (not expected)

decisions.choice: All views render from local fixtures; retry re-runs deterministic stub; offline is not a state
rationale: Matrix section I: zero network after install; missing fixture is a build defect, not a runtime state
No offline banner exists to build
risks: Builder adds network fetch or banner — Auditor flags as invented state
revisitWhen: If product adds real backend (out of Run scope)

risks: Hand-rolled tab semantics (EvidenceWing) and dialog trap/stacking (DrawerSheet) re-solve rung-5 problems with no installed primitive to verify against — Auditor must exercise ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End, trap, one-layer Esc, opener return, and right-over-left stacking explicitly.
Spine scrub + carriage without viewport yank is the highest-build-risk interaction (flagged in tournament carry-ins) — Builder must prove no-scroll-yank with streaming + scrub fixtures.
Status-by-hue drift: kind chips, collapse notes, and selection must stay neutral/tint-free; only status nodes, pills, diff, and edges carry hue — Auditor checks grayscale survival.
Attempt-keeping retry + dismiss-with-reason validation (confirm disabled until reason) spans ticket footer and topmost sheet — focus return and stacked-Esc paths need explicit proof.

Reduced-motion and offline rows apply globally — every animated state needs its static equivalent and every retry must be deterministic from fixtures; missing-fixture-as-defect must not become a runtime banner.
